## Download Boardly

| Your computer | File to download |
| --- | --- |
| **Windows** (installer) | `Boardly-…-windows-setup.exe` |
| **Windows** (no install, run from anywhere) | `Boardly-…-windows-portable.exe` |
| **Mac with Apple chip** (M1, M2, M3, M4…) | `Boardly-…-mac-arm64.dmg` |
| **Mac with Intel chip** | `Boardly-…-mac-x64.dmg` |
| **Any computer, no install** (opens in your browser) | `Boardly-…-browser-version.zip` → unzip → double-click `index.html` |

Not sure which Mac you have? Apple menu → **About This Mac** → look for "Chip: Apple…" or "Processor: Intel…".

### First launch

These builds are not signed with a paid Apple/Microsoft developer certificate, so your computer will ask you to confirm once:

- **Windows:** if "Windows protected your PC" appears, click **More info → Run anyway**.
- **Mac:** open the `.dmg`, drag Boardly to Applications, and open it. If macOS says it can't verify the app, go to **System Settings → Privacy & Security**, scroll down, and click **Open Anyway**.

Your boards are saved only on your computer. Use **⋯ → Back up all boards** to keep a copy.
